name: fitmatch-seo-intent
description: Build accurate Greek long-tail home fitness search experiences from user pain gaps with source evidence, not thin affiliate advertising.
---
# SEO for buyer problems
Target Greek queries like home gym for small apartment, walking pad versus treadmill, low-noise cardio apartment, adjustable dumbbells and 500 EUR buying advice.

Write helpful constraints, honest comparisons, fresh source citations, accessible summaries and contextual CTA back to the buying advisor. Do not invent product specifications, affiliate rates, merchant reviews or conversion data. No mass pages or keyword spam.

Staging stays noindex and production indexing requires merchant terms review, editorial QA and owner approval.
